scripts.install:all: npm install && cd native && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.dev:server: ZOVYRA_ROOT=$(pwd) cd server && npm run dev
scripts.dev: ZOVYRA_ROOT=$(pwd) concurrently --names "frontend,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:mobile:android: npm run dev:mobile:sync && cd frontend && npx cap run android
scripts.dev:mobile:ios: npm run dev:mobile:sync && cd frontend && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:native: ZOVYRA_ROOT=$(pwd) cd native && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: ZOVYRA_ROOT=$(pwd) cd server && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:no-native: npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:no-native && cd frontend && npm run tauri:build
scripts.build:android: npm run build:frontend && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run build:frontend && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:frontend && npm run cap:sync && echo 'Now open ios/App/App.xcworkspace in Xcode to archive/build (requires macOS + Xcode).'
scripts.start: ZOVYRA_ROOT=$(pwd) concurrently --names "frontend,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "cd frontend && npm run preview" "cd server && npm start"
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
scripts.clean: cd frontend && npm run clean; cd ../server && npm run clean; cd ../native && rm -f *.node
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean && npm run install:all
